name: DRV8353S
description: TI DRV8353S 9-75V three-phase smart gate driver (SPI configuration variant) -- candidate gate driver for the power stage, all amperage tiers (TODO.md 5.1).
verification: VERIFIED -- full 40-pin map read directly from the local copy of [21] (TI SLVSDY6A, AUGUST 2018, REVISED JUNE 2019), Sec. 6 'Pin Configuration and Functions', 'DRV8353S RTA Package, 40-Pin WQFN With Exposed Thermal Pad, Top View' and the accompanying 'Pin Functions -- 40-Pin DRV8353 Devices' table (which lists both the DRV8353H hardware-config and DRV8353S SPI-config pinouts side by side; only the DRV8353S column is used here). Sec. 5 'Device Comparison Table' confirms DRV8353S = 3 integrated shunt amplifiers, no buck regulator, SPI interface -- correct target part for this repo. The DRV8353H-only pins (GAIN, IDRIVE, MODE, VDS -- resistor-set config pins replaced by SPI registers on the S variant) are correctly absent from this pin map; the previous UNVERIFIED placeholder's guess that a 6x-PWM INHx/INLx pin set would apply is confirmed correct in spirit, though the previous placeholder's total pin count (26, sequential 1-26) and every individual pin number were wrong -- this device is a 40-pin WQFN (RTA package), not a 26-pin part. The datasheet's 'Exposed Thermal Pad' is not represented as a symbol pin, consistent with how this repo's other QFN/LQFP parts (MSPM0G3507, SLB9672) are modeled -- it is a footprint-level thermal/ground connection, not a schematic net requiring its own pin. Package (mechanical drawing, p.98, doc 4219112/A): RTA0040B, WQFN, 6.1x5.9mm body max / 5.9x... min (dual-tolerance box read as 6.1/5.9mm), 0.5mm pitch, ~4.15x4.15mm exposed thermal pad. `footprint` left blank rather than guessing a specific KiCad library footprint name -- no existing KiCad standard footprint was confirmed to match RTA0040B exactly; size a custom footprint from this drawing before fab.
